name: glamour

attributes.attribute: a spell that distorts human perception
lost its magical sense over time and came to mean a captivating charm
also used to break a glamour

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: A glamour is a spell that distorts human perception. The idea grew from the Roman fatae through the French faerie. The word fay-erie meant being under the power of the fays. In Scotland witches, fairies, or gypsies cast glamours. Such magic made people see things that were not there or not true. Over time the word lost its magical sense. It came to mean only a captivating charm. People could break a glamour with Fairy Ointment. A four-leafed clover or shamrocks also served. The glamour is a folkloric concept tied to the FAIRY entry.
